system_metadata.description: Distinct workbook architecture patterns for safe business reporting.

workbook_architecture_patterns.pattern_name: Raw data / clean data / analysis / output separation
workbook_architecture_patterns.when_needed: Any workbook with imports, transformations, pivots, or upload outputs.
workbook_architecture_patterns.minimum_viable_version: Four tabs or clearly marked zones: Raw, Clean, Analysis, Output.
workbook_architecture_patterns.larger_version: Separate tables, refresh log, schema checks, and protected output formulas.
workbook_architecture_patterns.manual_edit_zones: Raw paste/import zone only; no formulas overwritten.
workbook_architecture_patterns.protected_zones: Clean formulas, analysis pivots, output template.
ai_agent_modification_rules: never edit raw source except to replace whole extract
place transformations in clean layer
do not feed uploads from presentation-only output
workbook_architecture_patterns.business_user_explanation: Keeps original extract intact so problems can be traced and corrected.
